alert_data.message: This is a consolidated information from various alerts warnings. Please refer to the published_by for the source of information. For CAP related information, please refer to the official PAGASA website or social media accounts.

alert_data.headline: Thunderstorm Watch #NCR_PRSD
alert_data.message:
Thunderstorm Watch #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 10:00 AM, 22 November 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over Greater Metro Manila Area(Metro Manila, Bulacan, Rizal, Laguna and Cavite) within 12 hours. 

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

alert_data.headline: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9  #MINPRSD
alert_data.message:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9  #MINPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 22 November 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Bukidnon(Cabanglasan, Lantapan, Sumilao, ManoloFortich, DonCarlos, Maramag, CityOfValencia, Kadingilan), #MisamisOriental(CagayanDeOroCity, Villanueva, Tagoloan, Claveria, Manticao, Lugait), #LanaoDelSur(Picong, Malabang, Balabagan, Calanogas, Pagayawan, Tubaran, LumbacaUnayan, Lumbatan, Lumbayanague, Masiu, PoonaBayabao, Tamparan, Mulondo, BuadiposoBuntong, DitsaanRamain, Kapai, MarawiCity, Saguiaran, Taraka, Piagapo, Wao), #LanaoDelNorte(Linamon, Matungao, PantaoRagat), #AgusanDelNorte(LasNieves, RemediosT.Romualdez, Magallanes, ButuanCity), #MaguindanaoDelNorte(Buldon), #NorthCotabato(Alamada), #DavaoDeOro(Maco, Pantukan, Mabini), #ZamboangaSibugay(Diplahan, Buug, Siay, Titay, Ipil), #SurigaoDelSur(Carmen, Lanuza, CityOfTandag, Cortes, SanMiguel), #AgusanDelSur(Sibagat), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Gutalac, Kalawit, Labason) and #Sarangani(Malapatan) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Sarangani(Glan), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Siocon, Sirawai, Sibuco, Baliguian), #ZamboangaSibugay(Tungawan, RosellerLim), #ZamboangaCity, #AgusanDelSur(SanLuis, LaPaz, Esperanza, Talacogon, Prosperidad, CityOfBayugan, SanFrancisco, Veruela, Loreto, Bunawan, Trento, SantaJosefa, Rosario), #DinagatIslands, #SurigaoDelNorte(SurigaoCity, SanFrancisco, Malimono, Sison, Placer, TaganaAn, Gigaquit, Bacuag, Claver, Tubod, Mainit, Alegria), #AgusanDelNorte(Kitcharao, Jabonga, CityOfCabadbaran, Tubay, Santiago), #SurigaoDelSur(Carrascal, Cantilan, Madrid), #Bukidnon(Talakag, Baungon, Libona, Kalilangan, Pangantucan, ImpasugOng, Malitbog, CityOfMalaybalay), #LanaoDelNorte(IliganCity, Baloi, Tagoloan, Pantar), #LanaoDelSur(TagoloanII, Bubong, Maguing, LumbaBayabao, Butig, SultanDumalondong, Kapatagan, Marogong, Bumbaran), #MaguindanaoDelNorte(Barira and Matanog) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
